text: This landing reports the tracked mail Boolean, calendar Boolean and mail integer preferences, then registers an observer that updates only names in the mail Boolean/integer lists. The fixed accepted caller retains that order inside a best-effort idle task, whose comment permits it never running. Mail metric declarations explicitly use application lifetime; the inspected calendar declaration has no lifetime field. These source facts do not establish an SDK default, delivered ping value, or a calendar defect. The snapshot-only test export does not exercise observer registration.
title: Preference telemetry snapshots calendar values but observes only tracked mail preferences
